# Eight physical doorway passages, 22 September 2026

The operator confirmed **eight passages**. The requested sequence was alternating
OUT, IN, OUT, IN, OUT, IN, OUT, IN. There is no video or independent per-passage
direction label, so use that sequence as the test assumption, not verified ground
truth. Both devices monitored the same doorway.

The fixtures contain the browser recording from **17:18:35–17:19:25 +02:00**,
including several seconds of empty doorway before the first passage. JSON metadata
contains the original device event messages, approximate clock mapping, channel
availability and sample interval statistics. TSV files contain no network
credentials or Home Assistant data.

## Original observed outcomes

| Passage | Requested direction | Nede | Oppe |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | OUT | UNSURE_OUT | UNSURE_OUT |
| 2 | IN | IN | CANCELLED |
| 3 | OUT | CANCELLED (1 IN, 2 OUT) | CANCELLED (2 IN, 1 OUT) |
| 4 | IN | UNSURE_IN | OUT |
| 5 | OUT | CANCELLED (1 IN, 1 OUT) | OUT |
| 6 | IN | CANCELLED (1 IN, 1 OUT) | IN |
| 7 | OUT | CANCELLED (2 IN, 1 OUT) | OUT |
| 8 | IN | UNSURE_OUT | UNSURE_OUT |

All unique captured ROI measurements within this window have range status 0
(valid). Channels nevertheless disappear: U8 on Oppe is missing throughout the
eight passages, U4 disappears afterward; Nede U4 has a 7.6-second sample gap and U7
has a 2-second gap. The trace does not preserve I2C return codes, so this cannot
establish why they disappear.

Median per-ROI sample spacing is approximately 107–113 ms on Oppe and 80–85 ms on
Nede. The actual recorded trigger spans approximately 200–316 mm, despite the
configured 200 mm threshold, because of the original adaptive noise formula.

## Reproduction

Build the replay against the actual firmware and test stubs:

```sh
c++ -std=c++17 -Wall -Wextra -Wno-unused-variable -Wno-unused-parameter \
  -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-omit-frame-pointer -g -Itests/stubs -I. \
  tests/replay_capture.cpp components/tof_overdoor_counter/tof_overdoor_counter.cpp \
  -o /tmp/roode-replay-capture
/tmp/roode-replay-capture observed tests/fixtures/doorway_20260922_oppe.tsv
/tmp/roode-replay-capture raw tests/fixtures/doorway_20260922_oppe.tsv
/tmp/roode-replay-capture filtered tests/fixtures/doorway_20260922_oppe.tsv
/tmp/roode-replay-capture raw-strict tests/fixtures/doorway_20260922_oppe.tsv
/tmp/roode-replay-capture filtered-strict tests/fixtures/doorway_20260922_oppe.tsv
python3 tests/replay_capture_test.py
```

Repeat with `doorway_20260922_nede.tsv` for the other device.

The modes isolate different layers:

- `observed`: feeds recorded active/healthy masks to the current fusion core.
  This reproduced all eight original outcomes on both devices before the fixes.
  It uses the legacy untimed path interface and **does not exercise the new
  integration-time direction gates**. It is a compatibility check, not a test
  of the new complete algorithm.
- `raw`: deduplicates each ROI by its measurement timestamp, restores time order,
  and feeds captured raw range/status samples through the actual sensor-reading,
  health, debounce and fusion code. Baseline and estimated noise follow the trace.
  Integration timing is diagnostic only (`require_timing_evidence: false`, the
  firmware default).
- `filtered`: same as `raw`, but replaces the newly computed filtered distance
  with the original captured filtered distance to isolate downstream decisions.
- `raw-strict` and `filtered-strict`: enable the opt-in integration timing gate
  (`require_timing_evidence: true`) for the corresponding replay mode.

There are important replay limits. Snapshot gaps reach 257 ms on Oppe and 221 ms
on Nede, so intermediate measurements may have been lost. The old trace omits
pending debounce candidates and sensor initialization/I2C results. Raw replay
uses the recorded 1-sample median, trigger 200, release 80, debounce 25 ms,
clear 90 ms, agreement 3000 ms, 2 matching tracks and 3 healthy sensors.
Noise is reconstructed from the original formula `(trigger - 80) / 6`; values
at the configured floor only provide an upper bound on the real noise.

The old trace also omits integration-start timestamps. Raw/filtered replay now
estimates a conservative lower bound at one timing budget (33 ms) before the
previous same-sensor result. This allows for the old autonomous ranging pipeline
already integrating before that result was read. If there is no earlier result,
the fixture start minus the timing budget is used. These are explicit
reconstruction assumptions, **not observed timestamps**. The replay supplies
already completed results, so it bypasses the new live acquisition overrun/drain
scheduling; it cannot reproduce improved ROI acquisition from old measurements.

Before the fixes, raw replay reproduced every Oppe outcome but differed from
Nede at passages 2, 3 and 7. It is therefore a diagnostic comparison, **not a
lossless replay or a measurement of real-world counting accuracy**. Firmware
changes to ROI acquisition cannot correct previously mislabelled samples in
these old fixtures; validate those with a new live recording.

## Default versus opt-in strict diagnostic result

The new default `raw` replay preserves the old raw outcome sequence on both
devices and logs timing uncertainty. The opt-in strict gate confirms zero
passages in this old recording. It rejects previously correct counts as well as
the wrong-direction Oppe count, which is why **strict timing is not enabled by
default**. The default acquisition changes and short-range 20 ms profiles need
a new live recording; replay cannot infer improved accuracy from old samples.

| Passage | Nede old/default raw | Nede raw-strict | Oppe old/default raw | Oppe raw-strict |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | UNSURE_OUT | CANCELLED | UNSURE_OUT | CANCELLED |
| 2 | UNSURE_IN | CANCELLED | CANCELLED | CANCELLED |
| 3 | OUT | UNSURE_OUT | CANCELLED | CANCELLED |
| 4 | UNSURE_IN | CANCELLED | OUT | CANCELLED |
| 5 | CANCELLED | UNSURE_IN | OUT | CANCELLED |
| 6 | CANCELLED | CANCELLED | IN | CANCELLED |
| 7 | CANCELLED | CANCELLED | OUT | CANCELLED |
| 8 | UNSURE_OUT | CANCELLED | UNSURE_OUT | CANCELLED |

Default `filtered` matches default `raw` except Oppe passage 2 becomes
`UNSURE_OUT`, as it also did in the old filtered replay. `filtered-strict` and
`raw-strict` give identical outcome sequences. All eight runs (four modes on
each device) complete without ASan/UBSan errors. No expected-outcome assertion
is added for this uncertain old recording. A live trace with verified ROI
acquisition and actual integration timestamps is required before enabling
strict timing or judging real counting quality.

To extract another browser recording without retaining unrelated state data:

```sh
python3 tools/replay_capture.py recording.json fixture.tsv \
  --start 2026-09-22T17:18:35+02:00 --end 2026-09-22T17:19:25+02:00
```
